verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own natural-language control paths. Users can manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools through Brevo's Model Context Protocol integration, and Aura AI answers plain-language questions about account data. Supporting AI features also cover drafting copy and summarizing chats. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which operations the MCP/AI interfaces support beyond campaigns and contacts, in-product natural-language command execution (Aura is described only as Q&A), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Ask plain‑language questions and get instant answers from your data with Aura AI.
